full_name: Pardiss Kebriaei | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Law Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow Center for Constitutional Rights
bio: Pardiss Kebriaei is a senior attorney at the Center for Constitutional Rights, where she has worked since 2007 representing men detained at the US military base in Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, and other victims of US torture, detention, and killing programs over the course of the “war on terror” since 9/11.
